page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg8y.32xlarge is an arm64-based bare metal instance powered by the custom Alibaba Yitian710 processor. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs running at a clock speed of 2.75 GHz, paired with 512.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a balanced resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or GPU accelerators.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating high-throughput communication for distributed environments. Utilizing the custom Arm-based Yitian710 architecture offers qualitative cost efficiency advantages, as Arm-based designs typically deliver high compute density and lower power consumption compared to traditional x86 architectures. This makes the instance suitable for organizations seeking to optimize resource-to-cost ratios for large-scale deployments.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and high core count, this server type is designed for general-purpose workloads, multi-threaded applications, containerized microservices, and web serving. The lack of local storage means it relies on network-attached storage, making it suitable for stateless application tiers, distributed build systems, and enterprise applications that do not require local NVMe drives.
